task_05.instruction: Take the blue cube out of the steel pot and place it on the blue cube.

task_06.instruction: Take the red cube out of the steel pot and place it on the red cube

task_07.instruction: Stack the yellow cube on top of the orange cube.

task_08.instruction: Pick up the cube that makes the number of red and blue cubes on the wooden board equal, and place it in the empty corner of the wooden board.

task_09.instruction: Pick up the red cube from the wooden board, put it into the orange hollow cube, then pick up the orange hollow cube and place it on the wooden board

task_10.instruction: Pick up one orange block and stack it neatly on top of the other orange block

task_11.instruction: Take out the blue cubes from shortest to tallest and place it on the table
